name: Snoqualmie River (Fall City)
blurb: The Seattle-area summer tubing float below Snoqualmie Falls — short, warm(ish), and crowded on hot weekends.

sections.notes: Popular summer tubing stretch. Discover Pass required at Plum Landing (WDFW). The takeout marker shows the approximate Fall City Community Park area; identify the usable public river exit and trail before setting your shuttle.

notices.title: Approximate park takeout
notices.text: The marker locates the community park inland of the river. Follow the park’s public access trails and confirm the usable takeout before launching. WDFW’s Raging River ramp is a separate access upstream across the river.

putInAccess.operator: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife
putInAccess.sourceName: WDFW Facilities GIS, Boat Ramp layer (feature 271, concrete)
putInAccess.note: Batch 2. Coordinate is WDFW's own boat-ramp feature. Esri World Imagery (z19, checked 2026-10-25, research/raw/batch2/plum.png) puts it at the water's edge below the lot. Legal access: WDFW Plum page (https://wdfw.wa.gov/places-to-go/water-access-sites/plum-626) lists 1 concrete ramp, open year-round, with extra parking and a restroom 0.25 mi upstream at SE Fish Hatchery Rd and 372nd Ave SE; WaterAccessSites layer (https://geodataservices.wdfw.wa.gov/arcgis/rest/services/WP_RealEstate/WaterAccessSites/FeatureServer/1) shows WDFW-managed, no closure. Pass required.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHDPlus HR flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~323), the ramp is right of the NHD centreline. Confirmed on imagery.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Fall City Metropolitan Park District — Fall City Community Park
takeOutAccess.note: The park district confirms public river access in this King County park and links this inland park location. Its comprehensive plan shows the park boundary and river trails; County regulatory minutes document rafters and tubers taking out here. The old pending candidate was in this same park. This is separate from the WDFW Raging River ramp upstream across the river. No exact landing, river-bank side or shore connector has been verified.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use Fall City Community Park north of the SR 202 bridge. The park district lists parking and trails to the river. Identify the usable public takeout and access trail before launching; this marker locates the park area, not the shoreline.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

mapAuditNote: Plum Landing remains an exact WDFW ramp. Fall City Community Park is an agency-supported approximate access area with a separately reviewed section map. Its river course remains held because source geometry crosses a vegetated bar; no exact takeout or bank-side claim.
